title: Robotics Telemetry Processor
tagline: Embedded C++ sensor data pipeline filtering noisy MPU-6050 accelerometer and gyroscope signals for robot navigation.
description: Developed during my Advanced Robotics Summer Internship at IEEE Sensors Council Kerala Chapter × Luminar Technolab to stabilize mobile robot tilt calculations.

screenshots.title: Live Orientation Waveform
screenshots.caption: Filtered tilt estimation (blue) vs raw noisy accelerometer readings (red)

architecture: MPU-6050 IMU Sensor -> I2C Bus -> C++ Complementary Filter -> Serial Stream -> Python Plotter
database: Circular memory buffer on microcontroller holding 200 telemetry frames for real-time moving average calculation.
folderStructure:

├── src/

│   └── main.cpp

timeline: 2026: Advanced Robotics Summer Internship & C++ filter implementation
challenges: Eliminating cumulative gyroscopic drift over long operating intervals without incurring heavy floating-point calculation delay on 16MHz CPUs.
lessons: Filtering noise at the sensor intake layer prevents exponential error accumulation in downstream navigation algorithms.
futureImprovements: Port to ROS2 (Robot Operating System) node architecture on Raspberry Pi.
